rows.en:
I heard the rumors...
Apparently you've been hanging out a lot
with that guy lately.
rows.notes: Luca, jealous; shared m/f. 'ano otoko no hito' = 'that guy' (unnamed).

rows.en: (Okay, I'm gonna give it my all again today!)
U-um...
Hm? Did you need something from me?
rows.notes: x3, male player, to each of the three girls.

rows.en: This is...
rows.notes: Quiet Girl holding out the letter; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: A-a letter?!
F-for me?
N-no... It's for Michael-senpai...
rows.notes: She says Mihaeru-senpai: 'Michael-senpai' (glossary: Michael when the Japanese says Mihaeru).

rows.en: Right! Of course it is...
I-I'll be going now!

You're really showing off first thing
in the morning, huh?
M-Michel!

A love letter, huh...
Look at you, sneaking in some youthful romance.
It's addressed to you, though.
You should write back.
rows.notes: x3, male player to Michel; neutral about the sender.

rows.en: Yeah, yeah...
rows.notes: x10: Michel, Canaria (to Ozma), the player (to Nanase / Kagura), Luca; works for all.

rows.en: (What should I have for lunch...?)
Hey, hey!
Yup, yup. Sorry to ask, but... this...

As if!
It's for Michael-kun. Please give it to him!

Right! Of course it is...
I get it... I knew all along.
I'm counting on you!
rows.notes: onegai ne: she asks the player to deliver it.

rows.en: Haaah...
Showing off in broad daylight now, huh?
...Oh, it's you, Michel.

That's a love letter, isn't it...
Look at you, enjoying your youth.
It's addressed to you, though.
rows.notes: Same English as c01886 (the Japanese differs only by dakedo).

rows.en: Hmm...
(Another long day over. Good work, me.)
rows.notes: kyou mo ichinichi otsukaresama, said to oneself; shared m/f.

rows.en: Hey... got a minute?
Well, you see... it's about this.

...Save the sleep-talk for when you're asleep.
It's obviously for Michel-kun.
rows.notes: negoto wa nete iinasai (idiom: 'dream on'); she says Misheru-kun.

rows.en:
Right, of course it is...
Yeah, yeah... I get it... I knew all along.
See you, then.
rows.notes: x10: Stylish Girl, Shirakawa, Sheryl, Claire; works for all.

rows.en: Man, what is even going on~

What's up? If it's love advice you need,
I'm all ears.
M-Michel...

Looks like you got a love letter.
So, you gonna go out with her?
rows.notes: Shared m/f; every sender in this scene is a girl, so 'her'.

rows.en:
Like I'd ever get one...
I was just holding yours for you, Michel. Geez...
Ah, is that so, is that so...
Yup.
What's with that half-hearted answer...?

Don't sulk like that.
A jealous guy is not a good look.

Kidding, I'm kidding. Don't make that scary face...
Wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan?
Only if you're buying, Michel.
All right, all right.

(Geez, how many women is he planning
to make cry?)
Hm? Did you need something from me?

F-for me?
Um, I'm really not into girls like that...
rows.notes: sasuga ni onna no ko doushi tte no wa..., trailing off.

rows.en: Oh. Right, right...
M-Michel-kun!

A love letter, huh...
The sweet taste of love between girls...
Yeah, I could get behind that...
rows.notes: onna doushi no yuri no aji... sou iu no mo ari da yo na: Michel enjoying the idea; 'yuri' rendered as 'love between girls'.

rows.en: It's addressed to you, Michel-kun.
You'd better write back, okay?
For me?
...Oh, it's you, Michel-kun.

That's a love letter, isn't it...
You're a real heartbreaker, you know that?
It's addressed to you, though, Michel-kun.
Oh, is that so.
Make sure you write back, okay?
Oh, yeah. Of course it is.
M-Michel-kun...

As if!
I was just holding yours for you, Michel-kun.
Honestly...
Be sure to write back, okay?
What's with that half-hearted answer...?

I'd rather you didn't look at me like that.
You're ruining that cute face of yours.
Hmph!
Oh, all right... Wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan?
rows.notes: shou ga nai naa: Michel giving in to placate her.

rows.en: Fine, if it's your treat, Michel-kun.

(Honestly, how many girls is he planning
to make cry?)

uncertain: c01880/c01892: the girls say Mihaeru (Michael-senpai, Michael-kun) while the Stylish Girl and the player say Misheru (Michel-kun); kept the distinction as the glossary says.
c01924: Michel's 'yuri no aji' rendered 'the sweet taste of love between girls' rather than the loanword 'yuri'.
c01910: 'go out with her' shared by both player genders; all senders in ext_mcl_001 are girls.
